name: How long does it take to replace window casing?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to replace window casing?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required to replace window casing depends on the number of windows, the complexity of the trim profiles, and the type of material. For a single window with straightforward casing, the replacement might take a few hours. For multiple windows or custom, intricate designs, it could extend to several days. Exterior casing often takes longer due to weatherproofing considerations. A professional contractor can provide a more accurate timeline after assessing your project's scope.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replacement time varies based on the number of windows and casing complexity, ranging from a few hours for one window to several days for multiple.
